sentences.en: We get support from UC Davis, a globally ranked university working to solve the world's most pressing problems in food, energy, health, education, and the environment.
sentences.zh: 我们得到了加州大学戴维斯分校的支持，这是一所全球排名前列的大学，致力于解决世界在食品、能源、健康、教育和环境方面最紧迫的问题。

sentences.en: UC Davis researchers collaborate and innovate in California and around the globe to find transformational solutions.
sentences.zh: 加州大学戴维斯分校的研究人员在加州乃至全球范围内开展合作与创新，以寻找变革性的解决方案。

sentences.en: It's all part of the university's mission to promote quality of life for all living things.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是该大学促进所有生物生活质量提升使命的一部分。

sentences.en: Find out more at 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问 21stCentury.ucDavis.edu。

sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: If Dennis Baxter and Bill Whiston are doing their job right, you probably don't notice that they're doing their job.
sentences.zh: 如果丹尼斯·巴克斯特和比尔·惠斯顿的工作做得好，你可能根本注意不到他们在工作。

sentences.en: But they are so good at doing their job, you probably don't even know that their job exists at all.
sentences.zh: 但他们工作做得太出色了，你甚至可能根本不知道还有这份工作存在。

sentences.en: They are sound designers for televised sporting events.
sentences.zh: 他们是电视体育赛事的音效设计师。

sentences.en: Their job is to draw the audience into the action and make sports sound as exciting as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是让观众沉浸在比赛中，并让体育赛事听起来尽可能令人兴奋。

sentences.en: And that doesn't mean that they throw a bunch of microphones on the field.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着他们只是在赛场上扔一堆麦克风。

sentences.en: This is Dennis Baxter, sound designer of the Olympics.
sentences.zh: 这位是奥运会音效设计师丹尼斯·巴克斯特。

sentences.en: There's some sports that you just cannot capture the natural sound.
sentences.zh: 有些运动你根本无法捕捉到自然声。

sentences.en: Cross-country skiing, biathlon is another one because of the size of the course.
sentences.zh: 越野滑雪、冬季两项也是如此，因为赛道太长了。

sentences.en: And this has been further complicated because as the camera lenses have gone up 110, 120, 130, 140 to 1,
sentences.zh: 而且情况变得更加复杂，因为随着摄像机镜头倍率提高到 110、120、130、140 比 1，

sentences.en: these cameras are able to see a half a kilometer, maybe even a kilometer down the course.
sentences.zh: 这些摄像机能够看到半公里甚至一公里外的赛道情况。

sentences.en: Now, how do you replicate that sound?
sentences.zh: 那么，你该如何复制那种声音呢？

sentences.en: Essentially, if you've got cameras that are that far apart from each other,
sentences.zh: 本质上，如果你的摄像机彼此相距那么远，

sentences.en: you're putting 20 or 30 microphones to fill as the athletes are coming to you, which is not practical.
sentences.zh: 你得放置 20 或 30 个麦克风来填补运动员靠近时的声音，这并不现实。

sentences.en: I am not a purist whatsoever in sound production.
sentences.zh: 我在声音制作方面绝不是一个纯粹主义者。

sentences.en: I truly believe that whatever the tool takes to deliver a high-quality, entertaining soundscape, it's all fair game.
sentences.zh: 我真心认为，无论使用什么工具来提供高质量、引人入胜的音景，都是公平合理的。

sentences.en: And that has caused some issues because I use samplers.
sentences.zh: 但这引起了一些问题，因为我使用采样器。

sentences.en: What a sampler is, it's a keyboard.
sentences.zh: 采样器本质上就是一个键盘。

sentences.en: It's attached to essentially a digital recorder.
sentences.zh: 它连接着一个数字录音机。

sentences.en: When you hit the key on the keyboard, it triggers the sound to play back.
sentences.zh: 当你按下键盘上的键时，它会触发声音播放。

sentences.en: And with the keyboard, it also triggers with sensitivity, meaning that if I hit the key real hard,
sentences.zh: 而且键盘还带有力度感应，这意味着如果我用力敲击琴键，

sentences.en: it'll have a little bit more of a harder attack and you can vary the pitch.
sentences.zh: 它的起音会更强，而且你可以改变音高。

sentences.en: If I hit a C note that has a sample and then I hit a D note of the same sample, it will be up a step.
sentences.zh: 如果我弹奏一个带有采样音的 C 音符，然后弹奏同一个采样的 D 音符，它就会升高一个音阶。

sentences.en: So for the skiing, it gives a shh.
sentences.zh: 所以对于滑雪来说，它会发出“嘶”的声音。

sentences.en: Redgrave and Pinson still hold the lead.
sentences.zh: 雷德格雷夫和平森仍然保持领先。

sentences.en: The French in third, and we could do without seeing them at the moment.
sentences.zh: 法国队排在第三，我们现在可以不用看他们了。

sentences.en: In Atlanta, one of my biggest problems was rowing.
sentences.zh: 在亚特兰大奥运会上，我遇到的最大问题之一是赛艇比赛。

sentences.en: Rowing is a two-kilometer course.
sentences.zh: 赛艇赛道全长两公里。

sentences.en: They have four chase boats following the rowers, and they have a helicopter.
sentences.zh: 他们有四艘追逐艇跟随赛艇，还有一架直升机。

sentences.en: Okay, that's what they need to deliver the visual coverage of it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是他们进行视觉报道所需要的配置。

sentences.en: Okay, but the helicopter and the chase boats just completely wash out the sound.
sentences.zh: 但是，直升机和追逐艇的声音完全掩盖了现场声。

sentences.en: So no matter how good the microphones are, you cannot capture, you cannot reach and isolate sound like you do visually.
sentences.zh: 所以无论麦克风有多好，你都无法像视觉那样去捕捉和隔离声音。

sentences.en: But people have expectations.
sentences.zh: 但人们是有心理预期的。

sentences.en: Okay, if you see the rowers, they have a sound that they're expecting.
sentences.zh: 如果你看到赛艇运动员，你就会期待听到某种声音。

sentences.en: So what do we do?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该怎么办？

sentences.en: That afternoon, we went out on a canoe with a couple of rowers and recorded stereo samples of the different type of effects that would be somewhat typical of an event.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，我们划着独木舟带着几名赛艇运动员出去，录制了不同类型效果的立体声采样，这些效果在比赛中相当典型。

sentences.en: And then we loaded those recordings into a sampler and played them back to cover the shots of the boats.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将这些录音加载到采样器中，并在拍摄船只镜头时播放出来。

sentences.en: And the Australians have bitten something back from them, but not enough.
sentences.zh: 澳大利亚队追回了一些差距，但还不够。

sentences.en: Great Britain, gold medals!
sentences.zh: 英国队，金牌！

sentences.en: Stephen Redgrave, Matthew Pinson, mission accomplished.
sentences.zh: 斯蒂芬·雷德格雷夫，马修·平森，任务完成。

sentences.en: Stand by.
sentences.zh: 准备。

sentences.en: And they're racing.
sentences.zh: 他们出发了。

sentences.en: Good evening dispatch.
sentences.zh: 晚上好，调度中心。

sentences.en: When we do our horse racing, you're not going to get somebody running around the course after the horses.
sentences.zh: 当我们进行赛马转播时，你不可能让人追着马跑。

sentences.en: There's no way.
sentences.zh: 那是不可能的。

sentences.en: And occasionally you will come across very close-up pictures of the horses over the far side, which is done off one of our roving cameras.
sentences.zh: 偶尔你会看到远端马匹的特写镜头，那是用我们的移动摄像机拍摄的。

sentences.en: But you have engine noise in that case, so therefore you wouldn't want a microphone on that,
sentences.zh: 但在那种情况下会有引擎噪音，所以你不会想在上面放麦克风，

sentences.en: because all you would hear is the car revving up and the cameraman cursing.
sentences.zh: 因为你只会听到汽车加速的声音和摄像师的咒骂声。

sentences.en: So, basically, the way you cover all that sort of stuff is to run a tape which has the sound of horses who's galloping,
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，处理这类事情的方法是播放一段录音带，里面有马奔跑的声音，

sentences.en: which is actually, if I remember rightly, a slowed-down buffalo charge.
sentences.zh: 如果我没记错的话，那实际上是放慢了速度的水牛奔跑声。

sentences.en: That's pretty much a standard thing, and I think it's probably the same recording that they've used for years.
sentences.zh: 这几乎是标准做法，我想这可能就是他们多年来一直使用的同一段录音。

sentences.en: This episode of 99% Invisible is produced by Peregrine Andrews for Falling Tree Productions and features Dennis Baxter and Bill Whiston.
sentences.zh: 本期《99%隐形》由 Falling Tree Productions 的佩雷格林·安德鲁斯制作，丹尼斯·巴克斯特和比尔·惠斯顿参与录制。

sentences.en: It's an extract from the much longer and really stunning audio documentary called The Sound of Sport.
sentences.zh: 这是那部更长、非常震撼的音频纪录片《体育之声》的节选。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is made possible with support from Lunar, making a difference with creativity.
sentences.zh: 《99%隐形》的制作离不开 Lunar 的支持，他们用创造力创造了改变。

sentences.en: It's a project of KALW 91.7 Local Public Radio in San Francisco, the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 它是旧金山 KALW 91.7 本地公共广播电台、旧金山美国建筑师协会，

sentences.en: and the Center for Architecture and Design.
sentences.zh: 以及建筑与设计中心的一个项目。

sentences.en: To find out more, go to the website, it's 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 欲了解更多信息，请访问网站 99percentinvisible.org。
